zh-CN.title: 通知隐私设置更简单
items: 通知渠道取消自定义提示文案，隐藏内容后不再透露昵称、会话名称或消息正文
合并提醒仅展示涉及的会话数与消息总数

en.title: Simpler notification privacy controls
items: Custom notification copy has been removed; hidden alerts no longer reveal names, conversations, or message content
Digest alerts now show only conversation and message totals
